Package dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.internal

Class Space

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.internal.Space
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class Space extends Object implements AutoCloseable
What the handler keeps for one storage: the bytes its finished files hold, the bytes uploads have taken ahead of writing them, and its locks. It is read and changed only between enter() and close(), by one thread at a time; that is where a request checks what it may do and applies it, so two requests never act on the same state.

This one lives in memory, for a storage one process serves. The NIO engine's clustered directories keep the same in .dav, for several processes, by overriding the hooks below.
